capabilities: Draw freehand with pen, highlighter, and pressure sensitivity on multi-page sheets
Recognize and clean up hand-drawn shapes, lines, and angles held mid-stroke
Import PDFs as drawable backgrounds with clickable internal and web links preserved
Embed live, paginated sheet previews in notes with ![[sheet.draw]]
Export sheets to print-resolution PDF files
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Docs cover privacy, clipboard use, and mobile limitations (clipboard fallback may be less reliable). Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later; older versions keep receiving QuillStone 1.3.0.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to handwrite or draw with a stylus inside notes and embed the result as a live preview.

relations.evidence: The bundled PDF engine (pdf.js) has its code-generation paths removed at build time

summary: Handwritten drawing sheets that store strokes as diffable .draw files, with PDF import/export and live previews embedded in notes.
